description: Starts an AI job on an exercise video: a prompt-based edit, metadata suggestions, or chapter analysis. Use when the user wants to change an exercise video with words, auto-tag an exercise from its video, or split a class into chapters. Not for new clips from a trainer photo (use generate_video_clip). Returns a job ID and a progress card; results are suggestions or a new video, and the exercise stays unchanged. Uses 1 AI video edit from the team's monthly quota.

edit_type.description: What the AI does: conversationalEdit = edits the video from your prompt into a new version; autofillMetadata = suggests name, equipment, muscle groups and tags from the video; analyzeChapters = splits a class video into timed chapters.

exercise_id.description: ID of the exercise whose video to use. Get it from list_team_exercises.

locale.description: With autofillMetadata only: language for the suggested name, e.g. "fr-FR". Omit for English.

prompt.description: What to change, up to 2,000 characters; needed for conversationalEdit, e.g. "Make the background a bright studio".

name: start_video_edit
title: Start AI video edit
